snippet.title: 1348 Ex Voto Reveal Trailer- Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Sedleo dropped the reveal trailer for 1348 Ex Voto during this year's gamescom show. It's a third-person action-adventure about an odyssey of honour and justice across 14th-century Italy. It's coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox in 2026.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #1348exvoto #gamescom
